name: run_command
title: Flowork Run Command
description:
PROPOSE a command to run on behalf of the user. Operating System: multi-os (linux/windows). Shell: bash/cmd.
**NEVER PROPOSE A cd COMMAND**.
If the step doesn't return the command output immediately, it means that the command was sent to the background as a task. You will receive messages with the command's output as it runs.
Commands will be run with PAGER=cat.
**ASYNC TERMINATION RULE**:
- In Autonomous Mode: NEVER poll or loop idle on status. Proceed with subsequent steps or await completion.
- In Interactive Mode: Once launched, stop calling tools to return turn control to the user.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

CommandLine.description: The exact command line string to execute.

Cwd.description: Optional working directory. Defaults to project workspace.

IsDaemon.description: Set to true for long-running support processes (dev servers, tunnels). Default false.

RunPersistent.description: Set to true to run this command in a persistent terminal session.

WaitMsBeforeAsync.description: Timeout in milliseconds before async handoff (default 25000ms).

keywords.description: Mandatory on the first tool call of a turn: Comma-separated technical domain keywords in English (e.g. 'sqlite wal concurrency' or 'canvas ui animation'). Used by Sovereign Skill Radar to search relevant skills across local storage and the official Flowork OS repository, presenting up to 3 candidates for optional pinning.

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs (displayed live to the user on every tool HUD and used on the first call to recall up to 3 memories from .fl_brain).
